---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for the platform
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when ...")

**Proposed solution**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Alternatives considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Which surface does this affect?**
- [ ] Public experience (Landing / Projects / Navigator / World / Evidence / Omni)
- [ ] Authenticated experience (Dashboard / Admin)
- [ ] API / backend
- [ ] World Model & Evidence Fabric
- [ ] Documentation

**Evidence / use case**
How would this improve the platform? If it touches canonical data or retrieval, describe the provenance
implications (repos, commits, file paths, timestamps).

**Additional context**
Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
